title: Fence
body:
Apperance

The Fence is a schematic of a fence what you can build on your base.

Desc: Resizable fence schematic. Keeps the noobs out.

Trivia

  • This schematic scales accordingly to optimize the number of "legs" (vertical part) every few studs.
  • A similar looking structure appears on your base a few studs outside and varies in size based on your property size, and it appears whenever entry to said property is disallowed for said user. This fence is purely "holographic" and serves no point beyond a visual indicator to others that entry has been denied.
